description: This file contains unit tests for the LeaveRequestCommentAPI class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin, focusing on testing create, retrieve, and validation functionalities for leave request comments.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the LeaveRequestCommentAPI functionalities, including creating comments, retrieving all comments, and validation rules.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Tests that the API correctly returns an instance of LeaveRequestCommentService.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a leave request comment via the API, ensuring proper service interaction and response structure.

methods.name: testCreateLeaveRequestRecordNotFound
methods.description: Tests the create method handling of a non-existent leave request record (not found scenario).

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates that the create request validation rules correctly enforce required parameters.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all comments for a leave request, ensuring correct data retrieval and formatting.

methods.name: testGetAllLeaveRequestRecordNotFound
methods.description: Tests handling of scenario when leave request record is not found during getAll operation.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the request validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the delete method is not implemented and properly raises an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that validation rules for delete are not implemented and properly raise an exception.
